title: An orbit converging to an irrationally indifferent fixed point
exact_target: Can an orbit of an irrationally indifferent holomorphic germ approach its fixed point without ever landing on it?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300069 (AMR-052-0069). CC BY 4.0.

Ben Bielefeld, Mikhail Lyubich and contributors, \emph{Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics}, arXiv:math/9205209v1 (1992), Alexandre Eremenko and Mikhail Lyubich, ``Wandering Domains for Holomorphic Maps, Question 3.
